blocks.text: BTS emerged as the biggest winner at the 2026 MAMA Awards, taking home five trophies including two grand prizes as the two-day K-pop awards ceremony wrapped up in Osaka on Saturday. Held Friday and Saturday at Kyocera Dome Osaka, this year’s MAMAs divided its four grand prizes — artist of the year, song of the year, album of the year and fans’ choice of the year — across the two nights.
